issue_context.title: Clarify why HTML5 export templates are missing in 4.0 alpha builds
issue_context.body: ### Godot version 4.0.alpha3 ### System information MacOS 10.15.7 ### Issue description I cannot export project to webassembly. It seems that the webassembly export templates are missing. I can download export templates for 4.0.alpha3, but 'webassembly_release.zip' and 'webassembly_debug.zip' are missing: ### Steps to reproduce Project -> Export... ### Minimal reproduction project _No response_
comments:
HTML5 support is currently missing in Godot 4 because there is no production-ready OpenGL renderer yet. This is required for WebGL support, as Vulkan currently can't be used in a reliable manner on HTML5 (WebGPU isn't mature enough yet). See https://godotengine.org/article/about-godot4-vulkan-gles3-and-gles2 for more information.

I guess the option to export to HTML5 should be hidden from the editor for now.

We could make hide the option to create an HTML5 export preset for now, and replace it with a placeholder as was proposed for consoles: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/42359

What do you think?

I didn't really like the placeholder proposal back then so I wouldn't introduce it now.
We can maybe make the HTML5 export code `DEV_ENABLED` only, so contributors can still access it in `debug` builds to test future HTML5 templates but it won't be in release builds.

*Edit:* Alternatively, we can just hack in a warning that explains why there are no HTML5 templates when you select the preset. Might be best.

review_comments: I didn't bother making this translatable with `TTR()` as I envision this as a temporary solution, and current translations track the `3.x` branch anyway.
